import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import { FormElement } from '../catalog-support.js';
export declare class Checkbox extends FormElement {
    static formAssociated: boolean;
    static properties: {
        checked: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        defaultChecked: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
            attribute: string;
        };
        indeterminate: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        value: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        appearance: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    checked: boolean | undefined;
    defaultChecked: boolean | undefined;
    indeterminate: boolean;
    value: string;
    appearance: string;
    size: string;
    private state;
    constructor();
    get committedChecked(): boolean;
    resetControl(): void;
    restoreControl(value: string | FormData | File | null): void;
    updated(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private change;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
